svg.title: Grade → speed and heart-rate inertia
svg.desc: Two line charts of real Runsketch engine output. Left: running speed relative to flat ground peaks at 1.13× on a −8 % grade and falls to 0.70× at +10 %, walking follows Tobler’s curve with a 1.19× peak at −5 %, and the speed that would hold energy cost constant reaches 2.0× at −20 %, far above the 1.2× downhill speed cap. Right: when heart-rate demand steps from 120 to 150 bpm, heart rate covers 63 % of the step in 50 seconds; when demand drops back to 120 bpm it takes 160 seconds.
